question:

Searching for the missing files turned out to be nothing but a ______.
option_3: throw one’s hat into the ring
option_4: to put a spoke in one’s wheel
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. wild goose chase.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The idiom "Wild goose chase" means useless search.

◦ (निरर्थक प्रयास)

• The completed sentence reads: Searching for the missing files turned out to be nothing but a wild goose chase.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. wild goose chase.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: with might and main (पूरी ताकत से): This idiom means with full effort, which does not fit the context of the given sentence.

• Option 3: throw one’s hat into the ring (चुनौती स्वीकार करना): This idiom means decide to compete, which does not fit the context of the given sentence.

• Option 4: to put a spoke in one’s wheel (टांग अड़ाना): This idiom means create obstacles in someone’s progress, which does not fit the context of the given sentence.
